description: Figure 8 is a dual‑axis line plot illustrating how two metrics—perplexity and GPU memory ratio—vary as the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” changes. The x‑axis is labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 20% to 100% with tick marks at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. The left y‑axis is labeled “Perplexity” on a linear scale, ranging from about 4.2 to 4.7 with ticks at 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6, and 4.7. The right y‑axis is labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 40% to 100% with ticks at 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. One line (orange, solid, with small circular markers) is labeled “Perplexity” and starts near 4.65 at 20%, decreases to around 4.30–4.35 between about 40% and 70%, then rises to roughly 4.38–4.40 by 100%. The other line (blue, solid, with small circular markers) is labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem. Ratio” and increases gradually from about 42% at 20% to roughly 48–50% by around 80%, then rises sharply near the high end of the x‑axis to approximately 98–100% at 100%.
